setup.title: Unit K7 and the Golden Crack
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic, a gentle futuristic city with misty blue mornings and warm craft workshops.

cast.name: Unit K7
cast.description: Unit K7, a small knee-high cream ceramic robot with a round head, two glowing blue eyes, a hairline crack over its right eye, two brass antennae, and an orange canvas satchel worn across its body.

extras.voice: Unit K7, a small robot with a soft, slightly synthetic childlike voice, a gentle curious pace and a warm tone (S1),
extras.music: Delicate music-box melody with soft strings and a light glockenspiel, kept at low volume throughout.
extras.speech: K7 speaks only a few short, curious sentences to itself.

shots.prompt:
A wide, gently futuristic city plaza stretches under a cool, misty morning sky. Pale blue fog hangs low between sleek architectural towers, softening distant holographic signs and storefront illuminations into diffuse pastel glows of amber and cyan. The dark paving stones are slick with moisture, mirroring the hazy lights in long, glossy reflections. The atmosphere is calm and peaceful, enveloped in cool, damp air as the waking city stirs in the soft light.

Unit K7, a small, knee-high robot made of smooth cream ceramic, journeys across the wet plaza tiles. The automaton features a round head with two glowing circular blue eyes, two thin brass antennae, and a distinct hairline crack over its right eye. A small, empty orange canvas satchel hangs across its torso by a diagonal strap. Unit K7 waddles steadily across the damp stones, its little feet pattering against the ground while the orange satchel bobs against its ceramic flank. The brass antennae vibrate faintly with each step, and the hairline crack over its luminous right eye remains visible as it moves forward without stopping.

The camera tracks smoothly in a wide shot, positioned at a low angle just above the damp pavement. This framing accentuates Unit K7’s modest stature against the vast, towering backdrop of the foggy plaza. The reflective ground, the gentle sway of the satchel, and the hazy glowing signs in the distance remain visible throughout the shot, presenting a grounded, documentary-style record of the robot's morning journey.

annotation.beat: Morning in a wet futuristic plaza with glowing signs. Unit K7 waddles across the reflective pavement, satchel bouncing, the hairline crack visible over its right eye.

state.body_condition: cream ceramic with a hairline crack over the right eye

Unit K7 waddles forward. Just as it approaches a curb, a violent plume of white steam erupts straight from a metal floor grate, instantly engulfing it in dense fog. The lens remains steady as the steam explodes and drifts away, ensuring the fall and resulting damage are plainly legible, highlighting the newly widened fracture across the face plate against the wet ground.

Rows of wooden artisan stalls display handcrafted goods, pottery, and woven textiles, bathed in amber lamplight that reflects softly off damp paving stones. Navigating carefully around market baskets and passing legs, K7 gradually slows to a halt as its gaze locks onto a small hanging sign painted with an illustration of a golden bowl.

The camera moves in a smooth, low-angle tracking shot, retreating backward just above pavement level to match K7's walking pace. The framing keeps K7 centered in full view against the bustling market and tall stall posts. As K7 stops, the camera eases to a rest and tilts slightly upward, keeping K7's uplifted face and the illuminated sign framed together in the warm ambient light.

shots.prompt:
The interior of the kintsugi workshop glows with soft amber light spilling from hanging paper lanterns and small workbench lamps. Natural cedar paneling wraps the walls, lined with shelves displaying dozens of repaired ceramic vessels joined by gleaming seams of polished gold. Worktables are organized with horsehair brushes, jars of natural lacquer, and dusting powders. The atmosphere is quiet, contemplative, and still, carrying the faint, earthy scent of cured resin and aged wood.

At the threshold, Unit K7 pushes open the slatted wooden sliding door and steps quietly onto the timber floorboards. Across the room, an elderly craftswoman with silver hair pinned in a neat bun, wearing an indigo apron over a work shirt, looks up from her bench. Setting down a fine tool, she smiles warmly at the small visitor.

The camera holds in a steady medium wide shot, framing both the entrance and the artisan's workstation in balanced view. The composition stays stationary at a low-neutral height, preserving K7’s modest stature alongside the seated craftswoman. Soft lighting catches the golden seams of pottery resting on the background shelves, keeping the entire interaction quiet and intimate.

annotation.beat: K7 pushes open the sliding door of a warm wooden workshop full of repaired bowls with gold seams. An old craftswoman with silver hair in a bun and an indigo apron looks up from her bench and smiles.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a low-angle wide shot of a misty city plaza, where K7 walks steadily across the wet ground. Unit K7, a small knee-high cream ceramic robot with a round head, two glowing blue eyes, a hairline crack over its right eye, a golden kintsugi seam across its brow, two brass antennae with its left antenna adorned with a small red silk ribbon, glistening rain beads coating its surface, and an empty orange canvas satchel worn across its body, advances across the wet plaza. As it walks, a ground grate suddenly erupts with a burst of dense, hissing white steam pluming upward into its walking path. Unit K7, a small robot with a soft, slightly synthetic childlike voice, a gentle curious pace and a warm tone (S1) says: <d>[English] Careful now, step around the steam.</d> As soon as the line ends, K7 falls silent for the rest of the shot. K7 pauses for a fraction of a second, adjusts its footing, and smoothly arcs around the billowing cloud of vapor. Stepping past the vent, the robot resumes its steady stride into the foggy distance. The camera tracks parallel to K7 at ground level in a low-angle wide shot, maintaining the robot in view against the open expanse throughout the encounter.

overall_soundscape: A sharp, loud hiss erupts as pressurized steam bursts from the metal grate into the damp air. Wet ceramic footsteps patter softly against the slick pavement, backed by the subtle whir of small servomotors and distant misty urban ambience.
